priorities.P2: before smooth teacher use or reliable automated release

findings.summary: A non-null authored body stops build; direct edits to generated HTML are replaced; the template always renders a placeholder. Intentional Phase1 guard, but no usable content-authoring inlet yet.
findings.remedy: Separate authored lesson packages from generated records/site, then implement a validated loader/composer.
findings.acceptance: One noncurricular static package renders and survives rebuilds without generator changes; other KCs remain pending.

findings.title_fi: Täydennetty suunnittelutieto voi kadota onnistuneessa rakennuksessa
findings.summary: With body still null, learnerAction, contentReview notes/state and liteAlignment.reviewerNote were silently reset by a successful rebuild. Existing canonical/content-design sources were not lost.
findings.remedy: Own authored metadata in persistent sources; reject unsupported edits before overwrite; make derived records explicitly non-authoritative.
findings.acceptance: Supported authored metadata survives two builds and neighbouring updates, or invalid editing is rejected before loss.

findings.title_fi: Moduulien ja resurssien liittäminen on vasta kuvattu
findings.summary: Renderer lifecycle names are copied as metadata; no KC module loader/asset pipeline/lifecycle dispatcher exists. The verifier excludes curricular media and per-page script/style entries. This is consistent with the original empty phase.
findings.remedy: Implement a minimal optional module/asset boundary and prove it with one noncurricular interaction; no curricular Three.js scene needed.
findings.acceptance: Asset paths work under prefix, unrelated lessons do not load the module, reset/mount are repeatable and disposal stops work.

findings.summary: teacher-integration.lessonRevision is one global template/configuration hash. There is no separate per-KC authored content revision for review, feedback or incremental publication.
findings.remedy: Separate graph, template, KC content and runtime revisions; bind review/alignment evidence to exact content versions.
findings.acceptance: A single-KC content edit changes its revision without changing other KC content revisions or claiming old approval for new content.

findings.summary: Unavailable deployment plus self-consistent ready record/manifests and a rendered enabled WRONG-KC game link passed verification with zero failures. Shipped default links are correctly unavailable.
findings.remedy: Independently derive exact route and readiness from configuration/runtime membership; verify rendered open and copy actions against that result.
findings.acceptance: Wrong KC, missing index/endpoint and false classroom-ready states fail even when all file hashes agree.

findings.title_fi: Esitystila painottaa esitietolistoja ja katkeaa siirtymässä
findings.summary: In measured views lesson body starts below the initial viewport after long prerequisites. Dependency navigation drops presentation mode.
findings.remedy: Compact presentation navigation and disclose details while keeping every direct link; preserve presentation context across lesson navigation.
findings.acceptance: Technical lesson starts visibly in agreed desktop view; all neighbours remain available; following a link retains mode.

findings.summary: All24 alternative edges across12 any_of KC pages are labelled Vaadittu in flat top navigation, despite correctly preserved later OR groups. Reverse instances affect15 prerequisite pages.
findings.remedy: Render primary labels using group semantics; preserve raw strength/rationale in teacher source details.
findings.acceptance: All12 OR cases and reverse relationships communicate alternatives, especially M-ALG-08 and M-SCALE-02.

findings.title_fi: Palautuneet hakukentät ja hakutulos eivät aina täsmää
findings.summary: On recreated-document Chromium Back navigation, q=M-ALG-08 and Lite=yes remained in fields but690 rows and count returned. Reproduced twice; cache behavior may vary by browser.
findings.remedy: Synchronize filters during initialization/pageshow or use coherent URL-backed filter state.
findings.acceptance: Input values, visible rows and count agree on both cached and recreated Back navigation.

findings.summary: The documented export command fails outside Git because it unconditionally calls git rev-parse HEAD. Viewing/building/serving are unaffected.
findings.remedy: Support explicit/original manifest provenance without Git, or document the repository-only requirement; reject unrelated outer Git provenance.
findings.acceptance: Export succeeds from a clean standalone extract with honest provenance, or the restriction is explicitly documented.

scope_note: Content absence, missing live deployment and missing Lite runtime bridge were deliberately deferred. No current source graph defect was found.
